error[ZBX-E0222]: can't put the command in the container's cgroup
  while  running a command in the container web-1
  cause  the command was not started: it never runs outside the container's
         limits
  cause  systemd answered org.freedesktop.DBus.Error.AccessDenied: Refused
  scope  zbx-web-1.scope
  name   web-1
  pid    502
  fix    check the cgroup setup:   zbx doctor
  more   zbx explain E0222
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0222.html
